entries.name: Exchange Spell (Medium)
entries.description:
Upon reaching 5th level, and at every third class level after that (8th, 11th, and so on), the character can choose to learn a new spell in place of one he already knows. In effect, the character "loses" the old spell in exchange for the new one. The new spell's level must be the same as that of the spell being exchanged, and it must be at least one level lower than the highest-level class spell the character can cast. A character may swap only a single spell at any given level and must choose whether or not to swap the spell at the same time that he gains new spells known for the level.

Class Specific Restrictions

  • Occultist swapped spell must come from the same list of spells provided by the implement school of the spell lost.
  • Mediums are allowed to swap spells of all levels the medium can currently cast, even highest-level.
  • Hunters cannot swap any summon nature’s ally spells.
